messages:
mira: Kicking off mirror-swap for router-orbit -> promoting release v2.3.0. Plan: step weights 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100%, 5m observation between steps. Fallback: immediate rollback to v1 if error-rate jumps >2% absolute or p95 > 200ms. deploy-bot will annotate each step.

deploy-bot: Deploy job started: release/v2.3.0, job_id=deploy-3777772000. Created route tag: router-orbit:v2 (mirror mode enabled).

kaz: I validated the config in staging. I'll execute the weight updates from the control plane. Doing the 10% cut now.

kaz: Command I'm running:
```
curl -X POST "https://router-control.internal/api/v1/weights" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"service":"router-orbit","weights":{"v2":0.10,"v1":0.90}}'
```

deploy-bot: weight update accepted. Current weights for router-orbit: v2=0.10, v1=0.90. Health checks: ok.

teal: Quick check on infra: no session drain required (stateless). Just watch LB connection churn on edge nodes.

ryan: Observability checklist: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, request error-rate, auth failures. Dash: https://grafana.redwood/d/ops/router-orbit?orgId=1

mira: Good. Wait 5m and evaluate. If metrics stable, proceed to 25%.

kaz: Scheduling next step in 5m via orchestrator: `/orch schedule 3777772000 escalate 5m` — created.

deploy-bot: Escalation job created: escalate-3777772000 -> will run at +300s.

(deploy-bot automated check): After 5m: p95=118ms (baseline 115ms), error-rate delta=+0.3% (within threshold), 5xx unchanged.

teal: Observed small OOM retries on one edge shard, but retried successfully. No customer impact seen in logs.

mira: OK to proceed to 25%.

kaz: Applying 25% now. Command:
```
PATCH /api/v1/weights router-orbit {"weights":{"v2":0.25,"v1":0.75}}
```

deploy-bot: weight update accepted. Current weights: v2=0.25, v1=0.75. Health checks: ok.

ryan: After 2m: p95=122ms, error-rate delta=+0.7%. Still within our 2% threshold. No auth anomalies.

mira: Continue. Next hold 10m before 50% to watch for emergent issues.

kaz: Scheduled escalation to 50% at +600s. /orch job escalate-3777772000-2 created.

(deploy-bot automated check): 10m snapshot: p95=125ms, 5xx increased by 0.1%, error-rate +0.9%.

teal: Noting slightly higher CPU on two regional routers, but autoscale handled it. Keeping an eye.

mira: All right. Move to 50% when ready.

kaz: 50% done. PATCH applied. Current weights: v2=0.50, v1=0.50.

deploy-bot: weight update accepted. Canary validations: synthetic transactions passed end-to-end (auth, billing, embed pipeline).

ryan: Post-50%: p95=140ms (acceptable), error-rate +1.4%. Still under rollback threshold. No 5xx surge.

mira: Final ramp to 100% in 15m if stability holds. Remember: contingency rollback script: `./scripts/rollback-router-orbit.sh v1` — use if error-rate >2% or sustained p95 >200ms for >3m.

infra-sre: If you trigger rollback, also remove the v2 tag from the routing table to avoid half-applied states.

kaz: Scheduling final ramp at +900s. /orch schedule escalate-3777772000-final

deploy-bot: escalation job scheduled. Will run the final weight set to v2=1.00.

(deploy-bot automated check): 15m snapshot before final: p95=148ms, error-rate +1.6%, CPU back to baseline.

teal: No customer alerts, only minor retry spikes in regions eu-west and ap-south.

mira: Proceed to 100%.

kaz: Applying final weights now. PATCH -> v2=1.00, v1=0.00.

deploy-bot: weight update accepted. router-orbit now routing 100% to v2. Rolling old v1 to warm-down.

ryan: Post-cutover checks: p95=150ms, error-rate +1.7%, 5xx stable. Trace sampling shows no new error class.

mira: Great work. Closing the mirror-swap window. Release v2.3.0 promoted to primary. Please update release notes and tag changelog.

kaz: Done — release notes updated: https://confluence.redwood/display/RELEASES/v2.3.0

deploy-bot: Deploy job complete: deploy-3777772000 -> success. Annotation: mirror-swap completed, rollout 10->100% stepwise, no rollback.

mira: Thanks everyone. Postmortem: short retro if any customers report regressions. Otherwise we'll archive the ops log and add the weight commands to the runbook.
